claims.statement: The lowest-weight local-system term feeding W_26 H^26(M_{6,6}) under M_{6,6}->M_{6,5} is Gr^W_26 H^25(M_{6,5};H) with H the weight-one standard symplectic variation. The weight-two puncture graded piece of R^1 does not contribute to weight 26. The constant-coefficient R^0 contribution H^26(M_{6,5}) vanishes by the vcd bound k>4g-4+n of SRC-0002 p. 12. The R^2≅Q(-1) contribution reduces to W_24 H^24(M_{6,5}), which is pure Tate/algebraic by CKgP of M_{6,5}. Thus the proposed residual Gr^W_26 H^25(M_{6,5};H) is correctly formulated when H means the weight-one symplectic variation; it is incorrectly formulated if H is taken to be the full mixed R^1 of the five-punctured fibre or the weight-two puncture quotient alone.

For n<=c(6)=5, M_{6,n} has CKgP and W_k H^k(M_{6,n})=RH^k(M_{6,n}) is pure Hodge-Tate for even k (and vanishes for odd k). This discharges constant-coefficient pure-weight pieces on M_{6,5}, including the forgetful R^2 contribution, but does not control H^*(M_{6,5};H) for nontrivial symplectic H and does not cover M_{6,6}.

claims.statement: No theorem in the supplied primary corpus computes Gr^W_26 H^25(M_{6,5};H), proves it is pure Tate, or proves it vanishes. Local-system computations cited in the corpus (Petersen for genus 1/2 and A_2; Bergstrom-van der Geer Euler characteristics in genus 3) do not reach genus-six symplectic coefficients in degree 25. Even homology is proved pure Tate/tautological only through degree 14 (SRC-0002 Theorem 1.5(3)); degree 16 remains an open prediction (SRC-0001 Section 4; SRC-0002 Conjecture 1.8).

summary: Verified target for (g,n)=(6,6): dim d=21, ordinary group W_26 H^26(M_{6,6}) of expected untwisted type Q(-13), dual to W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16} with type Q(8) and Chow codimension 13. Under the forgetful map pi:M_{6,6}->M_{6,5}, the fibre is a five-punctured genus-six curve, so H^1(fibre) is mixed of weights one and two: Gr^W_1 is the weight-one standard symplectic variation H=R^1 of the universal compact curve, while Gr^W_2 is the weight-two puncture quotient. Only the weight-one graded piece feeds lowest weight 26 in total degree 26; the weight-two puncture quotient contributes weights >=27 and is not residual for W_26. After discarding the vanishing R^0 term (vcd of M_{6,5}) and the R^2≅Q(-1) term (pure Tate by CKgP of M_{6,5}, n=5=c(6)), the residual local-system obstruction is correctly Gr^W_26 H^25(M_{6,5};H) with H the weight-one symplectic variation—not the full mixed R^1 and not the puncture quotient. Formulating the residual as cohomology with coefficients in the mixed punctured-fibre local system, or as the weight-two puncture quotient, is incorrect. No cited theorem computes, forces Tate type for, or vanishes this group; constant-coefficient results through degree 14 and CKgP on M_{6,5} are relevant but insufficient. Global pure-Tate degree 16 remains open in SRC-0001 as of 2026-05-19, rechecked in corpus on 2026-07-30.
unresolved: No primary computation, vanishing theorem, exact point count, or equivariant stratification in the corpus controls Gr^W_26 H^25(M_{6,5};H) with H the weight-one standard symplectic variation on M_{6,5}.
Equivalent full forgetful residual package via SRC-0002 Lemma 3.1—direct sum over |lambda|=6 of W_26 H^{20}(M_6;V_lambda)—is likewise uncomputed; CKgP of M_6 controls only constant coefficients.
Global statement that H^16(Mbar_{g,n}) is pure Tate of type Q(-8) remains open as of SRC-0001 (arXiv 2605.20453v1, 2026-05-19), rechecked against corpus on 2026-07-30.
Point-count, Euler-characteristic, semisimplified Galois, and Conjecture 1.8 predictions do not discharge the exact residual Hodge structure.
